(1) It shall be lawful for the  Corporation from time to

column1: time at any general meeting of the Corporation and by the
votes of not less than two-thirds of the members present and
voting, to make rules, not inconsistent with the provisions of
this Act or any other written law, for the admission, withdrawal
or expulsion of members, the election of the office-bearers
and for the performance of the duties of such office-bearers,
agents,  officers  and  servants  of  the  Corporation,  for  the
procedure to be followed in the transaction of business by
the Corporation  and the Board of Management and generally,
for the management of the affairs of the Corporation and the
accomplishment of its objects. Such rules when made may at
a  like  meeting  and  in  like  manner,  be  altered,  added  to,
amended or rescinded.

column2: (2) All members of the Corporation shall be subject to the

column1: rules of the Corporation.

column2: The income and property of the Corporation shall be

column1: applied solely towards the promotion of the objects of the
Corporation as set forth herein and no portion thereof shall
be  paid  or  transferred,  directly  or  indirectly  by  way  of
dividend, loan, bonus, profit or otherwise, to the members of
the  Corporation.

column2: The Corporation shall be able and capable in law to

column1: acquire and hold any property both movable or immovable,
which may become vested in it by virtue of any purchase,
grant, gift, testamentary disposition or otherwise, and all such
property shall be held by the Corporation for the purposes of
this Act, and be subject to the rules of the Corporation under
section  7  it  shall  have  full  power  to  sell,  mortgage,  lease,
exchange or otherwise dispose of the same.

column2: All debts and liabilities of the Foundation existing

column1: on the day preceding the date of commencement of this Act,
shall  be  paid  by  the  Corporation  and  all  debts  due  to,
including  subscriptions,  fees  and  contributions  payable  to
the Foundation on that day, shall be paid to the Corporation
for the purposes of this Act.
